mapper.select: SELECT R.ROLE_ID AS "roleId" , R.NAME AS "name" , R.REMARK AS "description" , UR.STATUS AS "status" , UR.EFFECTIVE_DATE AS "effectiveDate" FROM USER_ROLES UR JOIN ROLES R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userID} AND (NULLIF(#{status}, '') IS NULL OR UR.STATUS = #{status}) AND R.STATUS = '01' ORDER BY R.ROLE_ID

SELECT DISTINCT P.PERMISSION_ID AS "permissionId" , P.NAME AS "name" , P.REMARK AS "description" FROM USER_ROLES UR JOIN ROLES R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID JOIN ROLE_PERMISSIONS RP ON RP.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID JOIN PERMISSIONS P ON P.PERMISSION_ID = RP.PERMISSION_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userID} AND (NULLIF(#{status}, '') IS NULL OR UR.STATUS = '01') AND R.STATUS = '01' AND P.STATUS = '01' ORDER BY P.PERMISSION_ID
